## P4 — Независимая приёмка и controlled-production gate

> **Phase Assurance | v1.**
> Impact: security-external
> Integration Seams: eis.live-probes · acceptance.evidence · production.controlled-gate
> Live or Irreversible: yes
> Audit Intent: auto
> Rationale: P4 individual owner gates for EIS traffic and controlled production remain mandatory. A separate phase audit is not default and requires a named residual-risk question plus explicit owner consent; it cannot replace or widen those owner gates.

## Phase Context

> **Контракт фазы (contract-first).** Потребляет: terminal/audited P0–P3 и D7/D8/D11/D12 · Производит:
> owner-authorized live A1/B2 evidence, затем независимый offline verdict A1–A9/B1/NEW-1/NEW-2/B2, terminal local-only P4.3 verdict
> с явным production deviation и post-gate B3 observability · Границы: local GREEN не превращается в production GO; B3 не является
> prerequisite P4.3, но нужен для terminal archive плана.

Scope Included: fresh-schema replay, targeted regression/fault injection, real PostgreSQL workers,
live source verification, controlled-production metrics/manual reconciliation, immutable raw evidence.
Scope Excluded: широкий production rollout, числовой SLA, LLM accuracy certification и unrelated
release work. RAG:— (repo-grounded: `@plan/knowledge/artifacts-PARSING_PRODUCTION_ACCEPTANCE.json:381-465`).

## Sequence and dependencies

P4.1 → P4.2 → P4.3. Post-gate B3 стартует только после verdict P4.3, но открытый B3 не блокирует сам
controlled-production decision; plan archive ждёт завершения B3.

## DoR (Definition of Ready)

- [x] Independent actor/context boundary задан Routing.
- [x] A1/B2 live evidence принадлежит только P4.1; P4.2 потребляет terminal state и digest-bound machine carriers offline.
- [x] B2 имеет обе fail-closed live branches и branch-specific Validation по D8/D11.
- [x] D12 терминально заменяет недоступный 72-hour deliverable local-only evidence и явным production deviation.
- [x] B3 отделён и явно не включён в launch gate.
- [x] Owner authorization требуется до любого live/production traffic.

## Phase Handoff

После P4.3 controlled-production verdict может быть принят; post-gate B3 закрывает observability и затем
план проходит финальный phase audit/close/archive.
